memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to me: "What they say is good. I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites, and I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him." - Deut 18:17-18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God confirms His promise and adds a beautiful detail, "I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him." This promised Prophet would speak nothing of His own invention. Every word would be God's own word, delivered faithfully and fully to the people.

This is exactly what we see in Jesus. Again and again He said that His words were not His own but the Father's. He told His disciples that He spoke only what the Father had given Him to say (John 12:49). Jesus perfectly fulfilled this promise, He told the people everything God commanded, holding nothing back, adding nothing false.

What confidence this gives us. When we come to the words of Jesus, we are not hearing mere human opinion or one teacher's perspective among many. We are hearing the very words of God, spoken through the perfect Prophet. His teaching carries the full authority and truthfulness of God Himself. This means we can trust Jesus completely, His promises, His commands, His warnings, and His comfort. We never need to wonder whether His words are reliable. God put His words in Christ's mouth, and Christ delivered them faithfully. How much weight do you give to the words of Jesus in your daily life?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you treat Jesus' words as the very words of God?
2. Which of Christ's teachings do you most need to trust today?
3. How would fully trusting His words change your life?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Jesus spoke Your words perfectly and faithfully. Help me trust and obey every word He has given us. Amen.
